content.title: Essential Steps to Protect a Believer’s Faith and Home During Puja
content.subtitle: Quranic and Sunnah guidelines to shield your family from the harms of shirk and evil jinn.
content.body:
Whenever praise and devotion are directed to other than Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala—the sole Sovereign of the heavens and the earth—Iblis and his rebellious jinn gather in large numbers. Due to chants, animal sacrifices, and polytheistic rituals, demonic disturbances increase significantly during these times. Walking past pandals heedlessly or mistakenly consuming food offered to deities can lead to spiritual vulnerability or afflictions by harmful jinn. For those living near such festivities, the solution is not panic, but establishing a solid shield of protection through the Quran, Sunnah, and Ruqyah.

(Note: These guidelines are based on scholarly advice for spiritual protection, without intent to disrespect any religious sentiment.)

1. Home Protection and Etiquette of Movement

  • Closing Doors and Windows: The Prophet ﷺ advised us to bring children indoors and close doors upon sunset, as devils disperse at that hour [Sahih al-Bukhari: 3280]. Recite Bismillah and keep doors and windows shut before Maghrib, especially those facing festival gatherings.

  • Keeping Children Indoors: Ensure young children remain safely inside during the evening hours as a Sunnah safeguard.

  • Duas for Going Out and Entering: If you must pass near these areas out of necessity, constantly recite ‘A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir rajeem’ and make the sunnah dua when leaving home:

  • «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ»(Tirmidhi: 3426).

  • Say Bismillah upon entering your home to prevent Shaytan from entering with you [Sahih Muslim: 2018].

2. The Shield of Ruqyah and Avoiding Offered Food

Recite your daily morning and evening adhkar as a family. Blow over young children who cannot recite yet:

  • Ayat al-Kursi & the 3 Quls: Recite Ayat al-Kursi and Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas three times after every fard prayer, before leaving home, and before sleep, wiping over your body [Bukhari: 2311; Tirmidhi: 3575].

  • Protection for Children: Seek refuge for your children as the Prophet ﷺ prayed for Hasan and Husayn (ra):

  • «أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ» (Sahih al-Bukhari: 3371).

  • Strictly Avoid Offered Food (Prasad): Consuming food dedicated to idols or deities is strictly prohibited in Islam [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 3]. Inadvertent consumption is a primary cause of severe spiritual harm.

3. Filling the Home with Quran and Istighfar

When the sounds of instruments, bells, or chants reach your home, do not be unsettled. Instead, fill your home with Quran recitation and Ruqyah. Recite Surah Al-Baqarah, as the Prophet ﷺ said: "Satan flees from the house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited" [Sahih Muslim: 780]. Increase in Istighfar (seeking forgiveness), which keeps Allah’s displeasure and calamities away [Surah Al-Anfal: 33].

4. A Powerful Fortress to Break Shaytan’s Plots

The Prophet ﷺ stated that whoever recites this supplication 100 times in the morning and evening will have a secure fortress protecting them from Satan throughout the day and night [Sahih al-Bukhari: 3297; Sahih Muslim: 2691]:

«لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ ، وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ»

(This is also an immense protection in Ruqyah against the harm of polytheist jinn and occult influences.)

footer_button.hint: No harm from the unseen world can touch you or your family if you hold firmly to the armor of the Sunnah and place your complete trust in your Lord. Let our hearts and tongues echo the greatest declaration in the heavens and the earth—the Kalimah of Tawheed. Join the Tawheed Campaign to spread the testimony of Allah’s Oneness and foil Satan’s schemes. Make every act of dhikr an impregnable shield for your faith.
